steps.what: Open the current design brief and referenced drawing revisions in electrical CAD {OTHER} and {DOCS}; use native revision links and saved views to find the relevant sheets, then verify their applicability.
Discuss design intent, interfaces and unclear requirements with engineers, distinguishing agreed requirements from questions still needing engineering decisions.
Write the actual requirement clarifications and unresolved questions in the existing drawing notes; check their wording and revision references against the discussion before saving.
Save the checked final requirement notes in {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Configure native drawing revision links and saved views in electrical CAD {OTHER} and {DOCS}. Only finding the relevant sheets becomes shorter; the drafter retains the discussion and writes the actual requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant drawings can be scattered across revisions and sheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision references and views can make existing sheets easier to find.
tasks.still_hard: Design intent and conflicting interfaces require engineering discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unresolved design decision rather than recording a guess as a requirement.
tasks.altitude: A little less drawing navigation; consultation remains the core work.

reach.learn: Trace requirements to the correct circuit and drawing revision.

evidence.claim: Engineering document stores and CAD tools can expose revision references and saved views without interpreting design intent.

assumptions: Boundary is the drafter's consultation, drawing lookup and actual requirement notes, not the engineer's design labour. Shares are a scenario, not measured time.

The drafter selects project ID, drawing ID, revision and sheet from the existing design brief and checks them in s1. Missing links require manual search, fully retained within the remaining lookup time. No automatic structured interpretation of the discussion is assumed.
Try native links before custom code. Actual note writing and discussion remain unchanged. No new meeting report or separate approval ceremony is introduced.

The ordinary author check at the end of s3 binds the completed note for s4 under the requested commit gate; edits require rechecking. The same-system save has one fully retained share and produces no saving.
research_questions: Do saved revision views reduce lookup without hiding superseded references?

already_counted.description: Verify the retrieved sheets and their applicability.

incremental.description: Maintain saved drawing views and revision links.

approvals.approved_version: Final requirement notes checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lookup falls from 25 to 20 hours, less 1 upkeep hour. Zero if native views are already configured. Discussion, actual notes and save retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Resolve drawing problems with engineering staff

steps.what: Inspect the actual drawing problem, relevant design documents and existing issue history using electrical CAD {OTHER} and {PROJECT}.
Confer with engineering staff and affected personnel about the discrepancy, constraints and workable resolution; retain unresolved points explicitly.
Write the actual resolution, affected drawing references and remaining questions in the existing issue entry in {PROJECT}; check it against the discussion before posting.
Post the checked final issue update in {PROJECT}.

tasks.design: Keep problem inspection, discussion and the actual issue entry in the existing electrical CAD {OTHER} and {PROJECT}. Native issue references already support navigation in this scenario, so no new labour reduction is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The problem requires technical context and agreement between people.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing issue references make the relevant records accessible but do not determine the resolution.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting constraints and responsibility for a safe resolution remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when the explanation does not actually resolve the drawing discrepancy.
tasks.altitude: No demonstrated change in this consultation task.

reach.learn: Keep the affected revisions and unresolved interfaces explicit.

evidence.claim: An issue record can hold drawing references and agreed actions but does not itself resolve engineering disagreements.

assumptions: Boundary is the focal drafter's problem consultation through its actual issue update; implementing a drawing change is separate work. These are problem-resolution cases rather than the initial requirement consultation in task 21947.

Lookup, actual issue writing and post are split from the discussion before choosing zero. Native references and fields are assumed already configured; the drafter still reads the context and writes the resolution. No new administrative record is added.

The drafter supplies project and issue ID, affected drawing and revision, actual agreed action and unresolved questions in s1-s3. Missing information returns to the people involved, with all entry and clarification effort retained.

The s3 author check of the completed entry supplies the requested exact-version commit gate for s4 without an extra approval activity. Edits invalidate the check. The one-share post is fully retained.
No configuration or ongoing upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Whether any repeated lookup is still manual
research_questions: Is there repeated reference lookup beyond the already configured issue views?

already_counted.description: Write and check the actual problem-resolution entry.

incremental.description: No new system or process introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Final issue update checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lookup, discussion, actual issue writing and post are separately retained. No specific further change to the existing native issue workflow is established.

tasks.short: Measure actual cable routes and equipment clearances

steps.what: Measure actual installation distances, cable-route segments and equipment clearances on site using the appropriate measuring tools, checking access and the reference points.
Record the measured dimensions, units, route endpoints, obstacles and uncertain or inaccessible segments in the actual field notes.

Prepare the dimensional reference sheet in electrical CAD {OTHER}; use native dimension styles and route-segment totals from manually entered measurements, then check units, reference points, missing segments and every final value against the field notes.
Save the checked final dimensional reference sheet in electrical CAD {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native dimension styles and segment totals in electrical CAD {OTHER}. The drafter measures and captures the real site, enters the dimensions and checks the completed sheet before save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dimension labels and segment totals may be rebuilt when preparing the site reference sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dimension fields can calculate explicit route totals and reuse consistent units.
tasks.still_hard: Restricted access, changing routes and uncertain reference points require physical inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Identify when an apparent distance omits a real obstacle or inaccessible segment.
tasks.altitude: Less dimensional sheet assembly; site work remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Explain measured endpoints, exclusions and uncertainty.

evidence.claim: CAD dimension styles and numeric segment totals can format explicit measurements without measuring the site.

assumptions: Boundary is the drafter's actual measurement and reference-sheet preparation. It does not replace installation work or infer an as-built site from an old drawing. Shares are an adoption scenario.

The drafter produces project/location ID, segment ID, start/end reference, measured value and unit, observation date, obstacle and uncertainty in s1-s2. Manual transcription into CAD and all checking remain in s3; no sensor feed or free capture is assumed. Missing dimensions remain missing and require another measurement.
Native configuration precedes code. The only reduction is repeated dimension formatting and total calculation in s3; physical measuring and first capture stay fully retained.
The ordinary final author check at the end of s3 binds its completed sheet for s4, without a separate self-approval stage. Edits require rechecking. Save is one fully retained share.
research_questions: Can dimension fields preserve segment provenance and distinguish unmeasured gaps from zero length?

already_counted.description: Enter measurements and check native sheet assembly against field notes.

incremental.description: Maintain dimension styles, units and total checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final dimensional reference sheet checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native formatting and totals remove 35% of the 19-hour sheet preparation share: 6.65 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Measuring, initial capture and save remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop a lighting-system design within engineering constraints

steps.what: Read and verify the applicable lighting requirements, current room geometry, supply constraints and approved component data in {DOCS} and electrical CAD {OTHER}.
Choose the proposed lighting arrangement and circuit grouping within the drafter's existing competence and engineering constraints, identifying issues requiring an engineer's decision.
outputs: proposed lighting arrangement and circuit grouping

steps.what: Develop the design drawing and explicit load schedule using electrical CAD {OTHER}; configure native symbol properties, circuit labels and connected-load totals, reviewing all generated values and associations.
inputs: proposed lighting arrangement and circuit grouping
outputs: draft lighting design and load schedule

steps.what: Check the completed design against the requirements, geometry and supply constraints, resolve drafting errors and mark unresolved engineering decisions before saving the final design draft.
inputs: draft lighting design and load schedule

steps.what: Save the checked final lighting design draft and load schedule in electrical CAD {OTHER} with its actual draft status.

tasks.design: Configure native symbols, circuit properties and load schedules in electrical CAD {OTHER}. Keep arrangement decisions and substantive design checking with the drafter; stored outputs remain design drafts under the existing engineering review process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Symbol attributes, circuit labels and load schedules may be maintained repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD properties can drive consistent labels and arithmetic from explicit design choices.
tasks.still_hard: Lighting suitability, installation constraints and exceptions need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a technically consistent drawing that still fails the real design intent.

ambition.what: Compare an additional lighting arrangement for constrained rooms when the engineering brief calls for alternatives.

tasks.altitude: Less label and schedule maintenance, with design authority unchanged.

reach.learn: Present input limitations, load assumptions and unresolved design choices.

evidence.claim: Electrical CAD properties can populate circuit labels and connected-load schedules from explicitly entered equipment and circuit assignments.

assumptions: Boundary is a lighting-design instance through the stored draft, within existing drafter competence. Engineering approval, installation release and procurement are separate and gain no saving here. Shares are illustrative.

Requirement owner supplies room use and lighting criteria; project documents supply verified geometry and supply limits. The drafter verifies these in s1 and enters room, luminaire and circuit IDs, actual selected component ratings, counts, placement and circuit assignment in s2-s3. Manual entry, missing-data clarification and generated-field review remain counted. No load or component choice is inferred from an incomplete brief.

Try native property and schedule configuration before code. Savings concern repeated symbols, labels and schedule arithmetic only; no automatic safety certification or broader design authority is claimed.

s4 is the normal completed-design check, not an added self-approval activity. It binds the exact draft for the requested s5 commit gate; edits require rechecking. The save retains its real one-share time. Alternative design demand is conditional and not counted as current saving.
unknowns: Actual drafter design remit and engineering handoff
research_questions: Do native symbol properties keep all circuit labels and load schedules consistent under a design revision?

already_counted.description: Review generated design fields and check the completed design.

incremental.description: Maintain symbol properties, load formulas and revision checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final lighting design draft checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native symbols and schedules remove 40% of the 30-hour drawing and schedule preparation share: 12 gross hours less 2 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Design decisions, substantive final checking and save remain fully retained.
